cell.label: History of any combination of the following: nausea, vomiting, pallor, cold sweats, hypersalivation, hyperventilation, headaches
Symptoms occur only with motion stimulus (e.g., car, boat, airplane).
History strongly suggestive of motion sickness; consider treatment with scopolamine.
Symptoms occur in absence of motion stimulus?
Consider vertigo workup as appropriate by clinical history: migrainous vertigo, Meniere's disease, labyrinthitis, acoustic neuroma.
Symptoms occur only with rapid, brief changes in head position?
Consider BPPV (benign paroxysmal positional vertigo); evaluate with Dix-Hallpike maneuver.
